d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, Surat wali Style me Tawa Pulao Banane ki recipe share kar raha hu, ye Mumbai wale tava pulav se kaafi alag hai aur bahut jaldi ready hota hai - 10-15 minute me ban jaega agar bache hue chawal ready hai toh.. Aap bhi try kariega super lagta hai, maine pulav ke saath raita ki bhi recipe share ki hai!
Ingredients:
Basmati rice - 1 cup
Salt - to taste
Haldi - 1/4 tsp
Peas - 1/2 cup
Oil - 2 tbsp
Jeera - 1 tsp
